subject: MATHEMATICS
title: Numbers in Symbols and Words
objective: Connect standard, expanded, and word forms.
introduction: Milo wrote 2,048 three ways! Help him match the symbol, expanded form, and word form.

vocabulary.definition: A symbol or word that tells how many, like 2,048.
The order of places in a number: ones, tens, hundreds, thousands.
A sign, like 2,048, that stands for a number.

items.prompt: Which statement about number forms is true?

options.text: Different forms can represent the same whole number.

items.explanation: 2,048, two thousand forty-eight, and 2,000 + 40 + 8 are all different forms of the same number.

items.prompt: Which number is written as two thousand forty-eight?
items.explanation: Two thousand forty-eight means 2 thousands and 48, written as 2,048.

items.prompt: Which is NOT another form of 2,048?
items.explanation: Two hundred forty-eight is 248, not 2,048. The other choices both name 2,048.
2,048 is read as two thousand forty-eight: 2 thousands, 0 hundreds, 4 tens, and 8 ones.
Two thousand forty-eight is the correct word form of 2,048. 20,048 is twenty thousand forty-eight, and two hundred forty-eight is 248.
